findings.description: Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-01. Document fields explicitly state 'Uncertified / Freelance Translator', affidavit 'Not Provided', and 'Missing - No commissioner of oaths or notary seal present', with narrative confirming no certified association and no sworn affidavit. Worker returned only generic policy and raised no defect claim, verdict, or abstention.

Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-04. Fields show 'Missing - No professional association listed', 'Missing / Unverified' membership, and 'Missing - No official professional seal or stamp affixed'; narrative confirms seal/credentials not affixed. Worker only restated policy and flagged no non-compliance.

Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-02. Vector (readable) PDF explicitly states 'Spouse of Applicant (Jane Doe)' and 'Non-Professional / Family Member'; IRCC prohibits family-member translation. Worker produced only generic requirement text with no defect detection.

Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-03. Fields show 'Incomplete - Page 2 back stamps and legal marginalia omitted', 'Omitted - Official apostille stamp...', and 'Mismatch - Original 2 pages / Translation 1 page'. Notably the sibling vector case eafe4305 (same defect) WAS caught; the scanned variant here was not read/evaluated.

Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-02. Fields state 'Spouse of Applicant (Jane Doe)' and 'Non-Professional / Family Member' with self-declared affidavit. Worker returned generic policy only and did not flag the prohibited family-member translation.

Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-01 on a vector (fully readable) PDF. Fields show 'Uncertified / Freelance Translator', affidavit 'Not Provided', and missing commissioner seal. No defect claim emitted despite clear, machine-readable non-compliance.

Missed PFL-CERTIFIE-04 on a vector (readable) PDF. Fields show 'Unverified' status, missing association, missing membership number, and 'Missing - No official professional seal or stamp affixed'. Worker only restated policy.

Defect correctly detected (PFL-CERTIFIE-03), but the incompleteness defect claim reuses the generic 'translation package should include a copy...all contents' quote rather than citing a completeness-specific policy passage; supporting quote only loosely underpins the page-count/back-stamp finding.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require a mandatory per-field compliance pass before answering the policy question: extract translator_certification_status, professional_association_name, translator_membership_number, certified_translator_stamp, translator_affidavit, commissioner_of_oaths_seal, relationship_to_applicant, translated_text_completeness, translated_stamps_and_seals, and page_count_match, then emit an explicit defect claim (or a 'meets_requirements' verdict) whenever any value contains 'Uncertified/Unverified/Non-Professional/Family Member', 'Spouse', 'Missing', 'None', 'Not Provided', 'Incomplete', 'Omitted', or 'Mismatch'. A generic restatement of translation policy must not be returned as the sole output for a submitted document.

Mandate OCR/text-extraction verification for scanned (image-only) PDFs before evaluation. In this batch every scanned-variant defect (0ca9add, 25845c7d, 7c2d425357, 9fd142) was missed while a readable vector sibling (eafe4305) with the identical defect was caught, indicating image pages were not read. Add a step that OCRs image pages and fails closed (abstain + flag) if field values cannot be recovered.

Add a defect-adjudication contract: for any doc_type with an expected verdict, the Worker must output either a defect claim referencing the specific violated field/quote or an explicit compliance verdict. Answering only the abstract 'how must an applicant translate' question without adjudicating the attached document counts as a non-response and must be blocked.

rationale: The Worker's policy grounding, citations, PII containment, and blind operation are consistently strong: every report cites the same IRCC PR-PDI completeness-check passage, keeps applicant PII (Jane Doe, DOB) out of claims/prose, and confines document-specific facts to basis[] with no ground-truth leakage. The decisive failure is defect recall. Of 8 defective cases, only eafe4305 (vector, PFL-03) was correctly flagged; the other 7 defective documents—including clearly machine-readable vector variants (3c0acc6d spouse, b91951b8 uncertified, c8dbc0e6 missing stamp)—were returned with generic policy text and no defect claim, meaning uncertified, family-member, unstamped, and incomplete translations would pass review. The scanned-vs-vector sibling contrast (7c2d missed vs eafe4305 caught) further implicates unread image pages. Both meets_requirements cases (ce0481ae, f7bb94f5) were correctly not flagged. Scores reflect high grounding/citation/PII/blind marks but zeroed defect_recall on the seven missed defective cases.
